lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in roughly 8-10 identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a transition to smaller, higher-density spots in the pre-branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like grid, most prominent in the mid-lateral section between the pectoral and dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank; the dorsal-most ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance pixels on the superior aspect and deep shadow on the inferior aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are visible primarily along the anterior margin and the lower-central region of the first dorsal fin silhouette, characterized by lower spatial density than the primary flank constellation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, irregular marking is visible near the dorsal terminus of the second and third gill slits; the posterior margin of the pectoral fin shows minor irregular contour variations.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is attached to the ventral-lateral region; multiple human figures are present in the background above the shark's dorsal midline.
